honestLimits: The extractor's unit vocabulary is a closed list. A quantity noun outside it fails CLOSED - no assertion is inventoried - so the failure mode is a missed detection, never a false accusation. That is the right direction to fail, but it IS a limit.

Grounding is rendering equivalence only. A source that states a figure in a form the grammar does not recognize (an unusual scale abbreviation, a wholly spelled-out currency amount) could still yield a false UNGROUNDED. The §15 scan found and closed one such class - the parenthetical-numeral form 'ninety (90) days' - before shipping; others may exist.

The evidence universe is the authenticated set. A figure the compiler legitimately took from a PARENT_SCOPE context item the verifier could not independently authenticate will read as UNGROUNDED. Widening the authenticated universe was explicitly out of scope and would have weakened the structured IR_ONLY detector.
§15's scan could grade only 112 of 700 preserved assertions; 588 were INSUFFICIENT_ARTIFACT. That is the harness gap this same mission closes for FUTURE runs, not for past ones.
